# ZishanHack

> Offensive security study resources by Zishan Ahamed Thandar, Cybersecurity Consultant. Digital products (notes, checklists, command references) for red teamers, penetration testers, and security researchers. Authored from practical exam and lab experience, not affiliated with or endorsed by Offensive Security or CyberWarFare Labs.

All prices are USD. All products are digital, delivered as an instant download after purchase, and include lifetime updates. All sales are final.

## Products

- [OSCP Prep Bundle 2026](https://zishanhack.com/products/oscp-bundle): Obsidian notes vault, tool installer scripts, copy-paste commands, Active Directory attack methodology, and exam-day methodology for OSCP preparation. Markdown/Obsidian format.
- [Ultimate Web Security Checklist](https://zishanhack.com/products/web-security-checklist): 32-page PDF with 300+ specific tests covering OWASP Top 10, API security, and logic flaws. Built for bug bounty hunters and web pentesters.
- [CRTA Exam Notes](https://zishanhack.com/products/crta): CyberWarFare Labs CRTA preparation. Active Directory attacks, Kerberoasting, BloodHound, Mimikatz, Impacket, Rubeus, and ligolo-ng pivoting commands.
- [OSWP Exam Notes & Cheatsheet](https://zishanhack.com/products/oswp-notes): Offensive Security OSWP preparation. Copy-paste commands for WEP, WPA-PSK, and WPA-Enterprise wireless attacks, plus rogue AP setup and assessment workflow.
